versos.hebraico: בָּעֵ֨ת הַהִ֜וא אָמַ֧ר יְהוָ֣ה אֵלַ֗י פְּסָל־לְךָ֞ שְׁנֵֽי־לֻוחֹ֤ת אֲבָנִים֙ כָּרִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ים וַעֲלֵ֥ה אֵלַ֖י הָהָ֑רָה וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ לְּךָ֖ אֲר֥וֹן עֵֽץ׃

controles.web: At that time Yahweh said to me, “Cut two stone tablets like the first, and come up to me onto the mountain, and make an ark of wood.
controles.kjv: At that time the Lord said unto me, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first, and come up unto me into the mount, and make thee an ark of wood.
controles.livre: Naquele tempo o SENHOR me disse: Lavra para ti duas tábuas de pedra como as primeiras, e sobe a mim ao monte, e faze para ti uma arca de madeira:

versos.hebraico: וְאֶכְתֹּב֙ עַל־הַלֻּחֹ֔ת אֶת־הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָי֛וּ עַל־הַלֻּחֹ֥ת הָרִאשֹׁנִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר שִׁבַּ֑רְתָּ וְשַׂמְתָּ֖ם בָּאָרֽוֹן׃

controles.web: I will write on the tables the words that were on the first tables which you broke, and you shall put them in the ark.”
controles.kjv: And I will write on the tables the words that were in the first tables which thou brakest, and thou shalt put them in the ark.
controles.livre: E escreverei naquelas tábuas palavras que estavam nas tábuas primeiras que quebraste; e as porás na arca.

versos.hebraico: וָאַ֤עַשׂ אֲרוֹן֙ עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים וָאֶפְסֹ֛ל שְׁנֵי־לֻחֹ֥ת אֲבָנִ֖ים כָּרִאשֹׁנִ֑ים וָאַ֣עַל הָהָ֔רָה וּשְׁנֵ֥י הַלֻּחֹ֖ת בְּיָדִֽי׃

controles.web: So I made an ark of acacia wood, and cut two stone tablets like the first, and went up onto the mountain, having the two tables in my hand.
controles.kjv: And I made an ark of shittim wood, and hewed two tables of stone like unto the first, and went up into the mount, having the two tables in mine hand.
controles.livre: E fiz uma arca de madeira de acácia, e lavrei duas tábuas de pedra como as primeiras, e subi ao monte com as duas tábuas em minha mão.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּכְתֹּ֨ב עַֽל־הַלֻּחֹ֜ת כַּמִּכְתָּ֣ב הָרִאשׁ֗וֹן אֵ֚ת עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֲלֵיכֶ֥ם בָּהָ֛ר מִתּ֥וֹךְ הָאֵ֖שׁ בְּי֣וֹם הַקָּהָ֑ל וַיִּתְּנֵ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָֽי׃

controles.web: He wrote on the tables, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which Yahweh spoke to you on the mountain out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly: and Yahweh gave them to me.
controles.kjv: And he wrote on the tables, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which the Lord spake unto you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly: and the Lord gave them unto me.
controles.livre: E escreveu nas tábuas conforme a primeira escritura, os dez mandamentos que o SENHOR vos havia falado no monte do meio do fogo, no dia da assembleia; e as deu a mim o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וָאֵ֗פֶן וָֽאֵרֵד֙ מִן־הָהָ֔ר וָֽאָשִׂם֙ אֶת־הַלֻּחֹ֔ת בָּאָר֖וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֑יתִי וַיִּ֣הְיוּ שָׁ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוַּ֖נִי יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: I turned and came down from the mountain, and put the tables in the ark which I had made; and there they are as Yahweh commanded me.
controles.kjv: And I turned myself and came down from the mount, and put the tables in the ark which I had made; and there they be, as the Lord commanded me.
controles.livre: E voltei e desci do monte, e pus as tábuas na arca que havia feito; e ali estão, como o SENHOR me mandou.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל נָֽסְע֛וּ מִבְּאֵרֹ֥ת בְּנֵי־יַעֲקָ֖ן מוֹסֵרָ֑ה שָׁ֣ם מֵ֤ת אַהֲרֹן֙ וַיִּקָּבֵ֣ר שָׁ֔ם וַיְכַהֵ֛ן אֶלְעָזָ֥ר בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃

controles.web: (The children of Israel traveled from Beeroth Bene Jaakan to Moserah. There Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest’s office in his place.
controles.kjv: And the children of Israel took their journey from Beeroth of the children of Jaakan to Mosera: there Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest’s office in his stead.
controles.livre: (Depois partiram os filhos de Israel de Beerote-Bene-Jacacã a Moserá: ali morreu Arão, e ali foi sepultado; e em lugar seu teve o sacerdócio seu filho Eleazar.

versos.hebraico: מִשָּׁ֥ם נָסְע֖וּ הַגֻּדְגֹּ֑דָה וּמִן־הַגֻּדְגֹּ֣דָה יָטְבָ֔תָה אֶ֖רֶץ נַ֥חֲלֵי מָֽיִם׃

controles.web: From there they traveled to Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of brooks of water.
controles.kjv: From thence they journeyed unto Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbath, a land of rivers of waters.
controles.livre: De ali partiram a Gudgodá, e de Gudgodá a Jotbatá, terra de ribeiros de águas.

versos.hebraico: בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֗וא הִבְדִּ֤יל יְהוָה֙ אֶת־שֵׁ֣בֶט הַלֵּוִ֔י לָשֵׂ֖את אֶת־אֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית־יְהוָ֑ה לַעֲמֹד֩ לִפְנֵ֨י יְהוָ֤ה לְשָֽׁרְתוֹ֙ וּלְבָרֵ֣ךְ בִּשְׁמ֔וֹ עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

controles.web: At that time Yahweh set apart the tribe of Levi, to bear the ark of the covenant of Yahweh, to stand before Yahweh to minister to him, and to bless in his name, to this day.
controles.kjv: At that time the Lord separated the tribe of Levi, to bear the ark of the covenant of the Lord, to stand before the Lord to minister unto him, and to bless in his name, unto this day.
controles.livre: Naquele tempo separou o SENHOR a tribo de Levi, para que levasse a arca do pacto do SENHOR, para que estivesse diante do SENHOR para servir-lhe, e para abençoar em seu nome, até hoje.

versos.hebraico: עַל־כֵּ֞ן לֹֽא־הָיָ֧ה לְלֵוִ֛י חֵ֥לֶק וְנַחֲלָ֖ה עִם־אֶחָ֑יו יְהוָה֙ ה֣וּא נַחֲלָת֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Therefore Levi has no portion nor inheritance with his brothers; Yahweh is his inheritance, according as Yahweh your God spoke to him.)
controles.kjv: Wherefore Levi hath no part nor inheritance with his brethren; the Lord is his inheritance, according as the Lord thy God promised him.
controles.livre: Pelo qual Levi não teve parte nem herança com seus irmãos: o SENHOR é sua herança, como o SENHOR teu Deus lhe disse.)

versos.hebraico: וְאָנֹכִ֞י עָמַ֣דְתִּי בָהָ֗ר כַּיָּמִים֙ הָרִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ים אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֔וֹם וְאַרְבָּעִ֖ים לָ֑יְלָה וַיִּשְׁמַ֨ע יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י גַּ֚ם בַּפַּ֣עַם הַהִ֔וא לֹא־אָבָ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה הַשְׁחִיתֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: I stayed on the mountain, as at the first time, forty days and forty nights: and Yahweh listened to me that time also; Yahweh would not destroy you.
controles.kjv: And I stayed in the mount, according to the first time, forty days and forty nights; and the Lord hearkened unto me at that time also, and the Lord would not destroy thee.
controles.livre: E eu estive no monte como os primeiros dias, quarenta dias e quarenta noites; e o SENHOR me ouviu também esta vez, e não quis o SENHOR destruir-te.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י ק֛וּם לֵ֥ךְ לְמַסַּ֖ע לִפְנֵ֣י הָעָ֑ם וְיָבֹ֨אוּ֙ וְיִֽרְשׁ֣וּ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתִּי לַאֲבֹתָ֖ם לָתֵ֥ת לָהֶֽם׃פ

controles.web: Yahweh said to me, “Arise, take your journey before the people; and they shall go in and possess the land, which I swore to their fathers to give to them.”
controles.kjv: And the Lord said unto me, Arise, take thy journey before the people, that they may go in and possess the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give unto them.
controles.livre: E disse-me o SENHOR: Levanta-te, anda, para que partas diante do povo, para que entrem e possuam a terra que jurei a seus pais lhes havia de dar.

versos.hebraico: וְעַתָּה֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מָ֚ה יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ שֹׁאֵ֖ל מֵעִמָּ֑ךְ כִּ֣י אִם־לְ֠יִרְאָה אֶת־יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ לָלֶ֤כֶת בְּכָל־דְּרָכָיו֙ וּלְאַהֲבָ֣ה אֹת֔וֹ וְלַֽעֲבֹד֙ אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בְּכָל־לְבָבְךָ֖ וּבְכָל־נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃

controles.web: Now, Israel, what does Yahweh your God require of you, but to fear Yahweh your God, to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your soul,
controles.kjv: And now, Israel, what doth the Lord thy God require of thee, but to fear the Lord thy God, to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve the Lord thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul,
controles.livre: Agora, pois, Israel, que pede o SENHOR teu Deus de ti, a não ser que temas ao SENHOR teu Deus, que andes em todos os seus caminhos, e que o ames, e sirvas ao SENHOR teu Deus contudo teu coração, e com toda tua alma;

versos.hebraico: לִשְׁמֹ֞ר אֶת־מִצְוֺ֤ת יְהוָה֙ וְאֶת־חֻקֹּתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּ֑וֹם לְט֖וֹב לָֽךְ׃

controles.web: to keep the commandments of Yahweh, and his statutes, which I command you this day for your good?
controles.kjv: To keep the commandments of the Lord, and his statutes, which I command thee this day for thy good?
controles.livre: Que guardes os mandamentos do SENHOR e seus estatutos, que eu te prescrevo hoje, para que tenhas bem?

versos.hebraico: הֵ֚ן לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וּשְׁמֵ֣י הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם הָאָ֖רֶץ וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר־בָּֽהּ׃

controles.web: Behold, to Yahweh your God belongs heaven and the heaven of heavens, the earth, with all that is therein.
controles.kjv: Behold, the heaven and the heaven of heavens is the Lord’s thy God, the earth also, with all that therein is.
controles.livre: Eis que, do SENHOR teu Deus são os céus, e os céus dos céus: a terra, e todas as coisas que há nela.

versos.hebraico: רַ֧ק בַּאֲבֹתֶ֛יךָ חָשַׁ֥ק יְהוָ֖ה לְאַהֲבָ֣ה אוֹתָ֑ם וַיִּבְחַ֞ר בְּזַרְעָ֣ם אַחֲרֵיהֶ֗ם בָּכֶ֛ם מִכָּל־הָעַמִּ֖ים כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּה׃

controles.web: Only Yahweh had a delight in your fathers to love them, and he chose their seed after them, even you above all peoples, as at this day.
controles.kjv: Only the Lord had a delight in thy fathers to love them, and he chose their seed after them, even you above all people, as it is this day.
controles.livre: Somente de teus pais se agradou o SENHOR para amá-los, e escolheu sua descendência depois deles, a vós, dentre todos os povos, como neste dia.

versos.hebraico: וּמַלְתֶּ֕ם אֵ֖ת עָרְלַ֣ת לְבַבְכֶ֑ם וְעָ֨רְפְּכֶ֔ם לֹ֥א תַקְשׁ֖וּ עֽוֹד׃

controles.web: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiff-necked.
controles.kjv: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiffnecked.
controles.livre: Circuncidai pois o prepúcio de vosso coração, e não endureçais mais vossa cerviz.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֚י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם ה֚וּא אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים וַאֲדֹנֵ֖י הָאֲדֹנִ֑ים הָאֵ֨ל הַגָּדֹ֤ל הַגִּבֹּר֙ וְהַנּוֹרָ֔א אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹא־יִשָּׂ֣א פָנִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א יִקַּ֖ח שֹֽׁחַד׃

controles.web: For Yahweh your God, he is God of gods, and Lord of lords, the great God, the mighty, and the awesome, who doesn’t respect persons, nor takes reward.
controles.kjv: For the Lord your God is God of gods, and Lord of lords, a great God, a mighty, and a terrible, which regardeth not persons, nor taketh reward:
controles.livre: Porque o SENHOR vosso Deus é Deus de deuses, e Senhor de senhores, Deus grande, poderoso, e terrível, que não faz acepção de pessoas, nem toma suborno;

versos.hebraico: עֹשֶׂ֛ה מִשְׁפַּ֥ט יָת֖וֹם וְאַלְמָנָ֑ה וְאֹהֵ֣ב גֵּ֔ר לָ֥תֶת ל֖וֹ לֶ֥חֶם וְשִׂמְלָֽה׃

controles.web: He does execute justice for the fatherless and widow, and loves the foreigner, in giving him food and clothing.
controles.kjv: He doth execute the judgment of the fatherless and widow, and loveth the stranger, in giving him food and raiment.
controles.livre: Que faz justiça ao órfão e à viúva; que ama também ao estrangeiro dando-lhe pão e roupa.

versos.hebraico: וַאֲהַבְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־הַגֵּ֑ר כִּֽי־גֵרִ֥ים הֱיִיתֶ֖ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

controles.web: Therefore love the foreigner; for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt.
controles.kjv: Love ye therefore the stranger: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
controles.livre: Amareis pois ao estrangeiro: porque estrangeiros fostes vós em terra do Egito.

versos.hebraico: אֶת־יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ תִּירָ֖א אֹת֣וֹ תַעֲבֹ֑ד וּב֣וֹ תִדְבָּ֔ק וּבִשְׁמ֖וֹ תִּשָּׁבֵֽעַ׃

controles.web: You shall fear Yahweh your God; you shall serve him; and you shall cling to him, and you shall swear by his name.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt fear the Lord thy God; him shalt thou serve, and to him shalt thou cleave, and swear by his name.
controles.livre: Ao SENHOR teu Deus temerás, a ele servirás, a ele te achegarás, e por seu nome jurarás.

versos.hebraico: ה֥וּא תְהִלָּתְךָ֖ וְה֣וּא אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֣ה אִתְּךָ֗ אֶת־הַגְּדֹלֹ֤ת וְאֶת־הַנּֽוֹרָאֹת֙ הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָא֖וּ עֵינֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: He is your praise, and he is your God, who has done for you these great and awesome things, which your eyes have seen.
controles.kjv: He is thy praise, and he is thy God, that hath done for thee these great and terrible things, which thine eyes have seen.
controles.livre: Ele é teu louvor, e ele é teu Deus, que fez contigo estas grandes e terríveis coisas que teus olhos viram.

versos.hebraico: בְּשִׁבְעִ֣ים נֶ֔פֶשׁ יָרְד֥וּ אֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ מִצְרָ֑יְמָהּ וְעַתָּ֗ה שָֽׂמְךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ כְּכוֹכְבֵ֥י הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם לָרֹֽב׃

controles.web: Your fathers went down into Egypt with seventy persons; and now Yahweh your God has made you as the stars of the sky for multitude.
controles.kjv: Thy fathers went down into Egypt with threescore and ten persons; and now the Lord thy God hath made thee as the stars of heaven for multitude.
controles.livre: Com setenta almas desceram teus pais ao Egito; e agora o SENHOR te fez como as estrelas do céu em multidão.
